evidence: DIFF A hunk 1 (lines 1-2): migration header only - purpose line citing the HQ rulings plus 'Module dependency: puppetlabs-mysql 17.3.0' (header_modules ok).

DIFF A hunk 2 (+service_name => 'mysql' in class ::mysql::server): module-compatibility translation. Checked on the master: puppetlabs-mysql 17.3.0 params.pp Debian branch sets provider 'mariadb' for Ubuntu >= 20.04 (server_service_name 'mariadb'); the MySQL branch, the default before that change, has server_service_name 'mysql'. So setting it explicitly keeps the baseline's service. Node after apply: Service[mysqld] manages unit mysql (active), no mariadb packages installed. This is exactly the class_rulings.txt line 7 change (HQ batch-5 ruling 2); nothing else in the declaration changed.

DIFF A hunk 3 (+class { '::mysql::client': package_name => 'mysql-client', } directly after mysql::server): the module default moved here too. 17.3.0 params gives client_package_name 'mariadb-client' on Ubuntu >= 20.04 and 'mysql-client' in the MySQL branch. mysql::db does include 'mysql::client' (db.pp:70), so a baseline mysql_server + mysql_db node managed mysql-client; the declaration keeps that. It is exactly the class_rulings.txt line 13 change (HQ 2026-11-17 ruling 1). Disclosed: with mysql_server applied alone, this adds a resource the baseline did not have, Package[mysql_client] (mysql-client metapackage; run-1 log line 210 'created'). Its only dependency, mysql-client-8.0, is already installed by mysql-server-8.0 (apt-cache depends). The HQ ruling accepts this as a module-compatibility change. No other logic, resource or attribute changed. comments_preserved ok.
DIFF B: re-migration; it adds only the mysql::client line and the updated header text to the previous migrated content (service_name already present). DIFF A carries the whole claim (see above).
